name: Tamiyo
description: Tamiyo is a moonfolk planeswalker and scholar from Kamigawa, mother of Nashi, who chronicles the story of the Multiverse and wields story scrolls as magic.

summary.text: Tamiyo is a moonfolk planeswalker and scholar from Kamigawa, mother of Nashi, who chronicles the story of the Multiverse and wields story scrolls as magic.

bio.text: On Innistrad she calmed Jace's mind, linked minds with him, and fought Avacyn, then later shielded his mind so he could planeswalk away from Emrakul.
She helped bind Emrakul in the moon with a binding spell, reading a second scroll after Emrakul took over her body, and flew off without parting words.
On Kamigawa she raised Nashi and welcomed Ajani into her household.
She worked with Kaito to find Tezzeret and destroy his lab, but was captured and dragged through a portal by Tezzeret.
She was compleated by the Phyrexians and served Elesh Norn as a favored servant.
When Phyrexia invaded Kamigawa, she read a cursed scroll over Towashi that shattered Boseiju, and the Wanderer cut her down with Kyodai's power.
Later she appeared only as a scroll echo trapped by the Cult of Valgavoth, and Nashi released her and she dissolved into moonlight.

status.text: She is dead, killed by the Wanderer after being compleated, and her scroll echo dissolved into moonlight when Nashi freed it.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo drifts through Thraben Cathedral's chantry, investigating why Innistrad is off its axis.
timeline.quote: Despite the fact that her feet never touched the stone floor, Tamiyo thought about tiptoeing as she slowly drifted through the chantry of Thraben Cathedral.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo has come to the cathedral to study the oldest histories of Avacyn.
timeline.quote: Her latest line of research had brought her to the cathedral, where the humans of Innistrad housed their oldest histories of Avacyn.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo invokes the story He Who Frightens the Sun to blend in unseen among the cathars.
timeline.quote: The story invoked, its magic became real, and Tamiyo faded from view.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo finds a young planeswalker holding her field notes standing over a collapsed librarian.
timeline.quote: And standing over him...a Planeswalker.

timeline.summary: Jace, mad, commands her to help him; Tamiyo shields her mind and uses the story Original to calm his thoughts.
timeline.quote: But her mind withdrew to a far-off castle, and the winds could not reach her.

timeline.summary: Jace's eyes grow calm and he recovers his senses.
timeline.quote: The young human's eyes closed, and he took several deep, slow breaths.

timeline.summary: Jace introduces himself and Tamiyo asks about Jenrik, learning he did not survive Markov Manor.
timeline.quote: he didn't survive it.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo tells Jace to leave, warning that a mad telepath is a danger across planes.
timeline.quote: You need to leave, Jace.

timeline.summary: Jace offers to find out what afflicts Avacyn and stop her if necessary.
timeline.quote: I can find out what's afflicting her.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo says she is here only to understand and chronicle, and expects the plane to be doomed.
timeline.quote: I am not here to fix this world's problem. I am here to understand it.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo agrees to anchor Jace's mind if they link minds, and Jace accepts.
timeline.quote: But...in theory, I could anchor you.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo and Jace link minds, each learning the other's past and burdens.
timeline.quote: In an instant, he knew her.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo senses her veiling spell pierced as a powerful presence approaches.
timeline.quote: Jace, my veiling spell has been pierced.

timeline.summary: Avacyn arrives in the central chapel, wings bloodied and spear aflame.
timeline.quote: The angel hovered, her massive wings stained with fresh blood, her spear molten and ablaze.

timeline.summary: Avacyn brands Tamiyo an intruder and impure and attacks.
timeline.quote: Intruder. Invader. Rotmonger. Impure! IMPURE!

timeline.summary: Tamiyo fights Avacyn with the story Winter's Howl, freezing parts of her wings.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo let loose precisely targeted blasts of icy gale

timeline.summary: Avacyn freezes in place under Jace's mental assault while her light presses down on them.
timeline.quote: And then she froze.

timeline.summary: Jace learns that Avacyn is the source of the angels' madness but not its origin, and that she holds something else at bay.
timeline.quote: She's the source of the madness among the angels.

timeline.summary: Avacyn's light turns foul; she breaks free and tortures Jace.
timeline.quote: She reached down and placed her hand on his chest.

timeline.summary: Jace begs Tamiyo to read the iron scroll about Serra's realm; she refuses to open it.
timeline.quote: No, Jace. The scroll stays closed.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo tells the dying Jace that sometimes stories have to end.
timeline.quote: Sometimes, our stories have to end.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, seeing Jace and Tamiyo as demonic fiends, prepares to destroy them in Thraben Cathedral.
timeline.quote: One more gentle thrust and I will unmask these demonic creatures

timeline.summary: Avacyn blasts Tamiyo back against the wall with her light.
timeline.quote: I push toward her with my hand, and my light blasts the demon back.

timeline.summary: Jace demands to know what Sorin has done as Avacyn is gone, leaving the cathedral vacant.
timeline.quote: Avacyn was no more. The cathedral felt overly large now, somehow.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo warns of consequences and says the plane has lost its protector as the world shakes.
timeline.quote: The plane has lost its protector

timeline.summary: A tremor shakes the cathedral, shattering stained-glass depictions of Avacyn's face.
timeline.quote: The world rumbled again, this time under Jace's feet.

timeline.summary: Jace, shielding his mind with Tamiyo's teaching, is distracted by the warped angel overhead.
timeline.quote: This time it had been the sight of the warped angel in the sky overhead that had distracted Jace.

timeline.summary: Jace sees Emrakul for the first time, bigger than the others, with all of Innistrad following her.
timeline.quote: It was the first time he had actually seen Her: the titan, Emrakul.

timeline.summary: Jace resolves to bring the Gatewatch to Innistrad.
timeline.quote: It was time to bring the Gatewatch to Innistrad.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo refuses to come with Jace, saying that is not her path.
timeline.quote: No, Jace. That's not my path.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo shields Jace's mind so that he can planeswalk away.
timeline.quote: I will protect your mind so you can planeswalk

timeline.summary: A moonfolk, Tamiyo, flies into the clearing and silently talks mind to mind with Jace while Liliana watches.
timeline.quote: A moonfolk flew into the clearing, her eyes wide and breath short.

timeline.summary: Emrakul unfolds, growing countless tendrils and releasing a wave of power that hits every planeswalker.
timeline.quote: in that shifting Emrakul unfolded

timeline.summary: The other planeswalkers collapse under Emrakul's mental assault, except Jace, who casts a spell in response.
timeline.quote: The other Planeswalkers crumpled, all except Jace, who cast some type of spell in response.

timeline.summary: Jace watches in a window as Emrakul's lattices cover Tamiyo's eyes, mouth and hands, erasing her ability to see, speak and write.
timeline.quote: She is being erased.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo recalls Avacyn's words and says Emrakul cannot be destroyed and must be bound.
timeline.quote: We cannot destroy Emrakul. We must bind her.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo proposes attuning a binding spell to Innistrad's moon and linking it to Emrakul.
timeline.quote: I have a binding spell. A powerful one. I can attune it to the moon.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo begins reading her scroll and Jace fastens a glyph on the moon to Emrakul.
timeline.quote: A glyph flashed onto the moon

timeline.summary: Tamiyo, cut off from Jace's mind, reads a second iron-banded scroll, and a flood of mana pours into the spell.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo pulled out another scroll, a long scroll, a scroll with iron bands

timeline.summary: A silver beam from the moon stretches Emrakul toward it until she snaps, folds and collapses to nothing, bound in the moon.
timeline.quote: Emrakul was gone. They had won.

timeline.summary: Gideon asks Tamiyo to join the Gatewatch and she excuses herself.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo shook her head, excusing herself

timeline.summary: Tamiyo tearfully tells Jace that Emrakul took over her body to read the second scroll.
timeline.quote: It...she...took me over.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo reveals the scroll cast a changed spell that trapped Emrakul herself, leaving them unsure what they did.
timeline.quote: instead it fueled a spell that trapped herself here

timeline.summary: Tamiyo asks if they really won and flies off into the dark sky with no parting words.
timeline.quote: Eventually she rose and flew into the dark sky.

timeline.summary: Jace explains he has put word out through Tamiyo that the Gatewatch is ready to help.
timeline.quote: I've put word out through Tamiyo that the Gatewatch is ready to help.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, six months ago, Nashi plays hide-and-seek in Tamiyo's library on Kamigawa and finds a pale giant, Ajani, who is welcomed into the household.
timeline.quote: A pale giant stared down at him. One blue eye blinked.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo introduces Ajani as part of her story-circle and Nashi as part of her family.
timeline.quote: He's part of our family now.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo privately asks Ajani where Elspeth is and he says she is not coming.
timeline.quote: Where is Elspeth?

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Nashi overhears Tamiyo tell Ajani that Nashi's village was burned by planeswalkers at the behest of the criminal Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: It was at the behest of a planeswalking criminal named Tezzeret.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo says Tezzeret died three years ago, killed by Nashi's villagers and betrayed by comrades.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret died...three years ago, I think?

timeline.summary: Tamiyo comforts the sobbing Nashi and tells Ajani that actions have consequences.
timeline.quote: Actions have consequences,

timeline.summary: Ajani tells the children Elspeth's story, saying a monster struck her down in front of him.
timeline.quote: another monster struck her down

timeline.summary: Kaito fights a moonfolk with scrolls, who paralyzes him with a scroll spell.
timeline.quote: The moment she read the words, Kaito felt his entire body stiffen.

timeline.summary: Learning that Kaito knows of Tezzeret, the moonfolk releases the spell and introduces herself as Tamiyo.
timeline.quote: "I am Tamiyo," she said, voice as unwavering as steel.

timeline.summary: Kaito realizes Tamiyo is a planeswalker, and meets her son Nashi.
timeline.quote: "You're a planeswalker."

timeline.summary: Tamiyo tells Kaito that Tezzeret is the man with the metal arm and that he burned the nezumi village.
timeline.quote: Kaito learned that Tezzeret wasn't just a planeswalker—he was the planeswalker with the metal arm.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo reveals the Reality Chip and that the Wanderer and the emperor are one and the same.
timeline.quote: "The Wanderer and the emperor are one and the same."

timeline.summary: Kaito resolves to steal the chip immediately rather than wait as Tamiyo urges.
timeline.quote: And he wasn't about to wait for Tamiyo's permission.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo hides the henchmen with an invisibility spell, and the three planeswalkers flee Otawara.
timeline.quote: the three planeswalkers fled from Otawara in silence.

timeline.summary: Kaito, Tamiyo, and the emperor arrive in the emperor's garden in Eiganjo, and the emperor enters Kyodai's temple.
timeline.quote: She turned for the porch, slid open the door to Kyodai's temple, and disappeared inside.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Tamiyo find Kyodai reunited with the emperor, both in pain from the emperor's unstable spark.
timeline.quote: "Your spark is still unstable. You cannot remain on Kamigawa without help."

timeline.summary: Tamiyo places the Reality Chip on the emperor's hand and it fuses to her flesh, stabilizing her for a time.
timeline.quote: the wires fused to her flesh like veins pulsing with energy.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo urges destroying the Reality Chip, but Kaito objects and proposes destroying Tameshi's lab with Imperial detonators.
timeline.quote: "I'll destroy Tameshi's compound."

timeline.summary: Kaito and Tamiyo return to Otawara and find the lab unlocked and the kami gone, their beds covered in metallic ash.
timeline.quote: The only evidence of a kami dematerializing.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret appears and tells them the experiments are about testing the connection between body and soul for Phyrexia, thanking them for bringing planeswalkers to the lab.
timeline.quote: And kami are much easier to come by than what Phyrexia really needs."

timeline.summary: Kaito and Tamiyo realize it was a trap and that the experiments are about planeswalkers, and the henchmen close in.
timeline.quote: It was a trap—and Kaito and Tamiyo had walked right into it.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret restrains Tamiyo with the lab's equipment and holds star-blades to Kaito's throat.
timeline.quote: a strip of metal equipment tore from the ceiling and wrapped itself around her hand like a monstrous restraint.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer cleaves Jin-Gitaxias with her sword and frees Kaito and Tamiyo from the surgical tables.
timeline.quote: The Wanderer brought her sword down like a blow from the heavens and cleaved Jin-Gitaxias from his neck to his chest.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer, Kaito and Tamiyo defeat the henchmen in the compound and hold Tezzeret paralyzed; the Wanderer decides to bring him to Kyodai.
timeline.quote: "Yes. We will decide his fate together."

timeline.summary: Tamiyo removes the chip from the Wanderer's hand and then places it on her own hand to pilot a surveillance mech to Eiganjo.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo lifted the Reality Chip to the back of her own hand and pressed the panel to her flesh.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer disables a surveillance mech and the group flies to Eiganjo on its back, carrying Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: The mech let out a ragged groan before lowering its body to the ground

timeline.summary: Tezzeret wakes and flings Kaito's smoke devices, then jumps from the mech; Tamiyo loses control and the group jumps before the mech crashes.
timeline.quote: the mech exploding against the side of an Imperial apartment.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Tamiyo track Tezzeret as he heads for the emperor and fight him on the rooftops, with Eiko's dagger striking him.
timeline.quote: In his thigh was a gleaming dagger, the gold handle carved with the symbol of the Imperials.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret takes control of the chip on Tamiyo's hand, opens a portal and drags her away.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret yanked Tamiyo through the snapping light, and they both vanished from the rooftop.

timeline.summary: Teferi tells Karn and Ajani that the Phyrexians have taken Tamiyo.
timeline.quote: "but they took Tamiyo.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn enters with Phyrexian warriors, Tamiyo, and Jace's risen corpse, welcoming the survivors to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Welcome, weary travelers, to Phyrexia,

timeline.summary: Nashi shoots Tezzeret in Towashi's undercity and demands to know where Tamiyo is.
timeline.quote: Tell me where she is.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells the wounded Nashi that his mother still lives and will come for him.
timeline.quote: Your mother still lives.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo and Atraxa discuss Lukka's likely fate and Norn's strategy.
timeline.quote: Either way Phyrexia is served.

timeline.summary: Norn shows Tamiyo the night-lit city of Kamigawa and asks whether she still loves it and her family.
timeline.quote: Do you still care for your family?

timeline.summary: Realmbreaker pierces Kamigawa's city as Tamiyo watches a mother save her children, and a man in black deflects falling tiles.
timeline.quote: Realmbreaker pierces the earth.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo falters when told to welcome the old into the new, and Atraxa reprimands her.
timeline.quote: Insolence isn't tolerated here. You were given a command.

timeline.summary: Norn commands Tamiyo to return with Kamigawa under her control or be recycled.
timeline.quote: Return with Kamigawa under your control or be recycled into something that serves better.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo hovers over Towashi, removing the iron ring from the scroll she wrote and reading it as the Phyrexian assault begins.
timeline.quote: Hovering over the neon skies of Towashi, she holds the scroll in hand.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo reads the story of Urza, Karn and Memnarch, and her words shake Towashi, collapsing buildings and etching Phyrexian symbols.
timeline.quote: Each syllable she reads booms and reverberates, shaking the skyscrapers of Towashi.

timeline.summary: Boseiju bursts apart and oil pours from it, killing and dissolving the kami.
timeline.quote: Boseiju, the tree that once held this plane together, bursts apart.

timeline.summary: The scroll turns to oil in Tamiyo's hands as the story ends with Phyrexia's victory.
timeline.quote: This is how the story ends, and how it has always ended: with Phyrexia's victory.

timeline.summary: Kaito tells Kaya that Tamiyo has opened the scroll and is destroying Boseiju.
timeline.quote: And worse, Tamiyo did it. Opened a scroll.

timeline.summary: Kaito starts to climb Boseiju to confront Tamiyo and meets Nashi, who asks to try to reach his mother.
timeline.quote: That's my mom up there.

timeline.summary: Nashi calls to Tamiyo, who answers with his name before her body snaps around and she attacks.
timeline.quote: A shard of metal shoots toward them

timeline.summary: Tamiyo urges Nashi to join Phyrexia, and Kaito tells him to retreat as they fight.
timeline.quote: In the light of New Phyrexia, all are one.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo overpowers Kaito with scrolls and hangs him above Towashi, offering him surrender.
timeline.quote: Kaito flips feet over head before he knows what's happened, dangling far above Towashi.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer confronts Tamiyo, who holds Nashi and takes out the scroll bound by an iron band.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo reaches for a scroll at her waist, one bound with an iron band.

timeline.summary: Empowered by Kyodai, the Wanderer cuts Tamiyo down.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo falls.

timeline.summary: Nashi recalls the day the Wanderer killed what remained of Tamiyo, after she was compleated.
timeline.quote: his mind was transported back to the day the Wanderer killed what had been left of Tamiyo.

timeline.summary: Nashi practices story magic in the cactus forest with the memory of his mother, but falters when grief breaks his focus.
timeline.quote: Nashi faltered, and the sprout gave a weakened shudder before coiling back into the sand.

timeline.summary: Nashi relives a memory in which young Nashi, with a homemade bird gadget, is told by Tamiyo not to hide who he is.
timeline.quote: You are Nashi . That is who I'm proud of.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo's voice congratulates Nashi, who celebrates and plans to make her proud.
timeline.quote: "You did it," came Tamiyo's voice in a whisper.

timeline.summary: Two years earlier, Tamiyo offers to tell Jace the story of the vaults, relics of an ancient empire.
timeline.quote: Relics of an ancient empire long lost to history.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer tells Niko she killed Nashi's mother in the invasion; Niko argues Phyrexia is to blame.
timeline.quote: I was sorry to kill her.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer sees Tamiyo's scroll echo held in a device as a cultist records her stories.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo's scroll echo floated there, flickering in and out of focus, like it hurt her to be manifest.

timeline.summary: Cultists open a box and Tamiyo's shade appears; Nashi calls to her but she turns away.
timeline.quote: When they put it down, the top snapped open, and Tamiyo's shade appeared.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo tells Nashi the cult has been stealing her stories and she cannot be saved.
timeline.quote: They've been stealing my stories, Nashi

timeline.summary: Tamiyo asks Nashi to let her go.
timeline.quote: Let me go.

timeline.summary: Nashi pulls his mother's scroll from the ghost-trap, and Tamiyo dissolves into moonlight.
timeline.quote: before she dissolved into moonlight and was gone.

timeline.summary: Nashi says goodbye to his mother's empty scroll and leaves it behind.
timeline.quote: I hope you can rest now.

timeline.summary: Narset reflects on Ajani, Tamiyo and her lost spark, and Elspeth recalls the cost of bringing Ajani and Nissa back.
timeline.quote: It cost everything to bring him and Nissa back.

timeline.summary: Despite trying to remain impartial, Tamiyo repeatedly ends up at the center of events that will define the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: she has an uncanny knack for putting herself at the center of events that will define the Multiverse for generations to come.

relations.note: Uneasy temporary partners after linking minds.
relations.quote: Tamiyo, I just want to help.

relations.note: Avacyn sees her as an intruder to protect against.
She takes Jace and Tamiyo for demonic fiends.
relations.quote: The two fiends cower before me like a stain on the cathedral floor.

relations.note: They have touched minds and Jace knows her essence well.
relations.quote: Jace had touched Tamiyo mind to mind, knew the essence of her better than most.
Welcome back to Kamigawa, my friend,

relations.note: work together to destroy the lab
relations.quote: "I believe two planeswalkers are better than one,"

relations.note: cut her down with Kyodai's power
The Wanderer killed what remained of Tamiyo after her compleation.
relations.quote: the day the Wanderer killed what had been left of Tamiyo

relations.note: She says she killed Nashi's mother, who had been taken by Phyrexia; Tamiyo is not named on this page.
relations.quote: I was sorry to kill her.

relations.note: They hold her in a ghost-trap and steal her stories.
relations.quote: The people who took me have me connected to this ghost-trap to keep me here
She thought of Tamiyo and her story circle

pages_say.description: A soratami planeswalker from Kamigawa who chronicles truths, wields story scrolls as magic, and refuses to use the iron-bound scroll to save Jace.
A moonfolk planeswalker who warns that Avacyn's destruction will have consequences for the plane.
A moonfolk planeswalker who teaches Jace to shield his mind and protects it so he can planeswalk away.
A moonfolk planeswalker and scholar and mind-linked friend of Jace who has a binding spell and is possessed to read a second scroll.
A soratami scholar of Kamigawa who helped defeat Emrakul and passes word among planeswalkers on behalf of the Gatewatch.
A moonfolk scholar who raises Nashi and welcomes Ajani on Kamigawa in flashbacks.
A moonfolk planeswalker and gatherer of knowledge who is Nashi's mother and tells Kaito about Tezzeret and the Wanderer.
A moonfolk planeswalker who helps Kaito and is captured by Tezzeret.
A moonfolk planeswalker who bears the Reality Chip and is dragged through a portal by Tezzeret.
A planeswalker who has been taken by the Phyrexians.
The first planeswalker compleated.
A planeswalker compleated and serving among Elesh Norn's warriors.
A planeswalker who was compleated; Tezzeret recalls her flayed in Jin-Gitaxias's laboratory.
A compleated evangel who hesitates when Norn tests her loyalty over Kamigawa.
A planeswalker lost to Phyrexia.
A compleated planeswalker and storyteller who reads a cursed scroll over Towashi and shatters Boseiju until she is cut down by the Wanderer.
A planeswalker and former evangel who Ajani says is dead.
Nashi's mother, a planeswalker who recorded history and was killed after being compleated; her memories survive as an animated story scroll.
A dear friend who told Jace the story of the vaults.
Nashi's dead mother; her iron scroll was confiscated and Kaito steals it back for her family.
Nashi's mother, who died in the invasion and is not named on this page; the Wanderer says she was sorry to kill her.
Nashi's mother, present only as a scroll echo held in a device by the cult, which records her stories.
Nashi's mother, present as a scroll echo trapped in a ghost-trap who asks to be released.
A moonfolk planeswalker, Narset's friend, who loved to learn every story; she is spoken of as one who would have been glad of the meeting.
A friend who Narset notes was compleated.
An intrepid researcher and planeswalker devoted to documenting the story of the Multiverse while trying not to interfere in history.
